tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and added observation support a sink-modulated concave response. Fit both open siphon branches and the two archived sink-dependent competitors numerically, then submit the lowest-residual candidate for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; the six observations span a wide range of sink gradients.
The observed sink-gradient dependence supports static siphon candidates rather than the archived memory ODE; further trajectory measurements are not yet justified.
These are retained as numerical competitors rather than assumed to be the mechanism; the training residual selects among them and the two siphon branches.
